From 200 Balloons · Price: touch only, and balloons are fragile.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: inflate an object you touch into a floating balloon; a balloon of Bulk 1 can carry a Small creature up slowly. Or your stand puffs up part of a creature it touches (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude}): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1} (its swollen limbs) for 1 round on a failure; on a critical failure @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 2} and it also bobs off the ground, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} for 1 round. Once per turn your stand can do this as part of a Strike (1 action) against the creature it hits; the sudden swelling bruises it for 1d6 extra bludgeoning damage. 1 action: your stand overinflates a balloon and bursts it against a creature within 30 ft: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}); on a critical failure the bang knocks it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone} and leaves it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 round.
  • 5: Reaction, surge: inflate an incoming projectile into a harmless balloon (ranged Strike against you or an adjacent ally misses). The first use each fight costs no Stand Point. You can burst two balloons with one action, at different creatures. A creature that fails against your stand's puffing stays @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy} for 1 minute; its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} and enfeeblement still last 1 round.
  • 9: Inflate a creature's held weapon: it's harmless for 1 round (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates).
  • 13: Inflate a willing ally to float (fly Speed 15 ft) for 1 minute. The bloating Strike's bruise is 2d6.
  • 17: The reaction works against any physical projectile within 30 ft.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
